title: Australian Chicken Wrap
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make wrap filled with grilled chicken, corn, and creamy sauce.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper.
Grill the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 2-3 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
In a bowl, mix together the softened cream cheese and chopped cilantro.
Heat the corn kernels in a pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes or until lightly toasted.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the cream cheese mixture on the wrap, followed by the sliced chicken, toasted corn, and chopped cilantro.
